description: Four channels that each sum two inputs, scale the result from nothing to twice its size, and offer it both upright and inverted

params.text: Scales the sum of that channel's two inputs: silence at fully counter-clockwise, unchanged at the centre, twice the amplitude at fully clockwise

inputs.text: Added to the other input on the same channel, and the sum passed to that channel's GAIN control

outputs.text: That channel's two inputs added together and scaled by its GAIN control
That channel's two inputs added together, scaled by its GAIN control and inverted

notes: every GAIN knob comes up centred at 1x, so a channel passes its input unchanged until you move one.
nothing here is DC blocked or clamped, so the module passes audio and control voltages alike and will pass a signal larger than ±10V straight through.
